feed.title: NPR Programs: Morning Edition
feed.subtitle: Morning Edition takes listeners around the country and the world with multi-faceted stories and commentaries every weekday. Hosts Steve Inskeep, Leila Fadel, Michel Martin and A Martínez bring you the latest breaking news and features to prepare you for the day.

entry.title: With 4 weeks to go, a look at where November's big races stand
entry.summary: Election Day is four weeks away and people are already voting in the 2026 midterms. Where do things stand in the big races across the country?

entry.title: What challenges lie ahead for the Democratic Party as midterms approach
entry.summary: Democrats are feeling optimistic ahead of the midterms, but what challenges remain? NPR's A Martinez asks Devan Barber, who leads the Democratic Senatorial Campaign Committee.

entry.title: As Taiwan expands Arizona chip plant, China warns against developing political ties
entry.summary: The world's biggest chipmaker now manufactures at scale in Phoenix, as well as Taiwan. China is warning political leaders in Arizona to not get too friendly.

entry.title: New Hollywood era begins with an epic mega merger between Paramount and Warner Bros.
entry.summary: The Paramount and Warner Bros. merger has survived court challenges, public protests and regulatory scrutiny. Now, the Hollywood heavyweight, named Skydance, begins operating.

entry.title: Morning news brief
entry.summary: With just weeks to go, a look at where the midterm elections stand, Saudi-backed forces in Yemen launch a major counter-offensive, Paramount and Warner Bros. begin operations after merger.

entry.title: Meshell Ndegeocello pays tribute to classic duets with new album, 'Synonym'
entry.summary: NPR's Michel Martin speaks with Meshell Ndegeocello about her new album, "Synonym," featuring duets with the likes of Cynthia Erivo, Chaka Khan and Brandi Carlile.

entry.title: How the economy and other key issues are factoring into the midterms for Maine voters
entry.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel drives some 700 miles across Maine talking to voters about the issues that are shaping their decisions in the midterm elections.

entry.title: 'They don't invest in us': French students protest for more resources in schools
entry.summary: High school students in France are fighting for more resources in schools. Some of the protests have turned violent, but it's not clear whether students or the police are to blame.

entry.title: Democrats need to reel in more men. These Mainers say the party needs better bait
entry.summary: Democrats are trying to win back male voters ahead of the midterms. In Maine, some fly fishermen say frustration with both parties is shaping their votes.

entry.title: Saudi Arabia launches new military offensive against the Iran-backed Houthis
entry.summary: Saudi-backed forces in Yemen launch a major counter-offensive to drive back Houthis, supported by Iran
